last.verdict: Strong quarter, but a weaker fourth-quarter outlook and PC slowdown give investors pause.

reasons.label: Weaker year-end outlook
reasons.text: Q4 revenue guided to $15.0–16.0B, below Q3's $16.5B; gross margin falls to 38%.

reasons.label: PC slowdown continues
reasons.text: CFO expects the PC slowdown to last at least through the first half of 2027; PC chip sales fell 5%.

reasons.label: AI data center boom
reasons.text: Data center and AI sales jumped 78% to $7.3B; total revenue rose 21% to $16.5B.

story: Intel's recent reports show data center and AI demand driving growth. July's beat and raised outlook still saw shares fall 7.9% after a huge run. Rising spending and a soft PC market are the recurring worries, now joined by a softer Q4 forecast.

history.verdict: Strong beat and raised outlook, but shares sold off after a huge run.

reasons.label: Priced for perfection
reasons.text: Stock was up about 170% this year, so a big beat wasn't enough.

reasons.label: Huge paper loss
reasons.text: GAAP net loss of $11.0B, mostly a $12.5B non-cash charge tied to US government-held shares.

reasons.label: Rising costs and spending
reasons.text: 2026 capex raised to over $20B; memory and substrate inflation could squeeze margins.
